content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences describes itself as an autonomous super-specialty Institute of excellence under GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University by the UGC. Its work covers patient care, teaching and research in Liver, Gall Bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases. The Institute is located at D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070.

content_sections.heading: ILBS Assistant Professor and Consultant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Working knowledge of Computer is essential for all the posts. For the post reserved for OBC, only applications with an OBC certificate issued by GNCT of Delhi will be considered. Candidates with disabilities can apply as per the definition in the Persons with Disabilities (equal opportunities, protection of rights and full participation) Act, 1995. Only persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the benefit of reservation as PWD. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification and the Recruitment Rules page under Career Opportunities on the ILBS website.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Screening Committee screens all applications as per the Recruitment Rule of the post. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit. It would do this on the basis of qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed, along with other academic achievements. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct of the interview or the reasons for not being called.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: All seven posts are on "Contract Basis" for a period of one year. Either side can end the contract by giving the other not less than three months notice in writing, or salary in lieu of the notice period. The date of joining and other conditions for selected candidates follow the HR policy of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Other Conditions
content_sections.text: The vacancy is subject to change at any time, and the Institute may decide whether or not to fill any post. No appeal will be entertained. A vacancy may be removed from the website once the post is filled. A post that falls vacant can be added at the discretion of ILBS. The Institute may reject any or all applications without giving reasons. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. In any dispute, the jurisdiction of court will be Delhi/New Delhi only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Assistant Professor and Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the Recruitment Rules and category on the ILBS website to confirm your eligibility for the post. Download the ILBS application form (PDF) and fill it in. Pay the application fee by electronic transfer to the account given above. The application form also carries the payment details. Send the filled form and documents by email to [email protected] . Documents to send with the application: Photocopies of degree, certificate, diploma, testimonials and experience certificates A copy of a recent passport size photo The entry relating to date of birth from the matriculation certificate or SSLC Duly attested copies of the degree certificate or diploma

faq.question: Q1. Which ILBS post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Consultant (Anaesthesia) Grade IV has 3 posts, of which 2 are UR and 1 is OBC. Each of the other six posts has 1 UR vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. Can an OBC candidate from outside Delhi apply for the reserved Anaesthesia post?
faq.answer: For the post reserved for OBC, the Institute will only consider applicants who hold an OBC certificate issued by GNCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age for an OBC candidate applying for a 50-year post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is relaxable by 3 years for OBC candidates, and by 8 years for OBC persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q4. Do EWS candidates pay the full application fee?
faq.answer: No. EWS candidates pay Rs. 118/-, the same amount as SC/ST and Ex-Serviceman candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on a contract basis for one year, and either side can end it with not less than three months written notice or salary in lieu.

faq.question: Q6. Will every applicant get an interview?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates shortlisted after screening are called, and the Institute can limit the number on the basis of qualification and experience above the prescribed minimum.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the Recruitment Rules for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice directs candidates to the Recruitment Rules page in Career Opportunities on the ILBS website, www.ilbs.in.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I call with a query about this recruitment?
faq.answer: The HR department can be reached on telephone no. 011-46300000, Ex: 23234 and 23233.
